title: Genie Code is now available as a Lakeflow Jobs task (Beta)
body: You can now run prompts with Genie Code as a task in a Lakeflow Job. Genie Code runs your prompt autonomously. It can read upstream task outputs and call tools as needed. The task returns a link to the resulting Genie Code conversation with its response. See [Genie Code task for jobs](/aws/en/jobs/tasks/genie-code).
